snippet.description:
For much of history, cats were not seen as cuddly creatures. In fact, they were even compared to the devil. But now nearly 40% of U.S. households have one. So what changed? 

We look into how cats became beloved pets on Explain It to Me. Listen wherever you get your podcasts. 

Subscribe to our channel and turn on notifications (🔔) so you don't miss any videos: http://goo.gl/0bsAjO
